mentions.name: Struggle Meals
mentions.description: A personal recipe site called Struggle Meals collecting 'struggle meals' — recipes the author ate when feeling too poor, depressed, tired, or chronically unwell — alongside normal adulting recipes and meal prep. It features barebones content with design work underway, weighing trade-offs like tagging dietary attributes (vegan/vegetarian/GF/etc.), simplifying recipes (omitting measurements, separating critical from nice-to-have ingredients), and possibly pricing based on region, season, and discounts.
mentions.problem: Documenting the food the author ate when feeling too poor, depressed, tired, or chronically unwell, in a genre inspired by The Sad Bastard Cookbook and r/shittyfoodporn.
mentions.source_excerpt: I'm working on a personal recipe site called Struggle Meals, in the genre of https://traumbooks.itch.io/the-sad-bastard-cookbook and https://old.reddit.com/r/shittyfoodporn/, for food I ate when I felt too poor / depressed / tired / chronically unwell. Some of them are just normal adulting recipes. Some are meal prep. Some are too struggly for a legitimate recipe site.
